note: Every freely-downloadable candidate was checked against the pre-registered acceptance bar (n_items 150-900; nominal category per item; price-band present or honestly-absent; timestamped per-user purchases; >=~100 users with >=4 purchases so k-grid {0,1,2,3,5,8} is non-degenerate; license permits redistribution; post-restriction size < 300MB). None met ALL criteria, so none was standardized to a catalog. The bar was NOT lowered. This empty result is itself the corpus-contribution finding: the public small-catalog data landscape is genuinely thin and the two designated headline sources are gated.
